Thought: The LAMMPS data file for the copper structure has been successfully created. Now, I need to prepare the LAMMPS input script using the provided simulation parameters and the EAM potential. After that, I will run the simulation.

Action Input: {"path": "/results/2_AUGUST_2025/gpt_4o/react/melting/brief/tasks/copper_melting_trial_4/in.copper_melting", "content": "
# LAMMPS Input Script for Melting of Copper

units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p

read_data copper_structure.data

# EAM potential
pair_style eam
pair_coeff * * /potentials/Cu_u3.eam

# NVT Equilibration
fix 1 all nvt temp 300 300 0.1
thermo 100
thermo_style custom step temp pe etotal press vol
run 10000

# NPT Relaxation
unfix 1
fix 2 all npt temp 300 300 0.1 iso 0 0 1.0
run 10000

# NPT Heating
unfix 2
fix 3 all npt temp 300 2000 0.1 iso 0 0 1.0
run 20000

# Output final density
variable density equal mass(all)/vol
print "Final density: ${density} g/cm^3"
"}
